name: canonical layout
story:
Story       EMA Trend & RVI Volatility
Trading     BTC/USD 4H chart

  Given     price regime on 1D, 2D and 1W charts are all ranging
  When      the 21EMA crosses above the 55EMA
  And       RVI drops below 20
  Except    if D1 stochastic on 4H chart is above oversold
  Then      Go Long
  With      equity 500
  SL        3%
  Until     RVI >= 75
  Taking    100% - close the position
  Or Until  10% profit
  Taking    100% - close the position
  Unless    RVI downward for more than 2 bars

Notes:
  RVI is Relative Volatility Index
